encoding: Existing local System.Drawing encoder, shared 255 visible colors, transparent index0; source alpha>=128 retained as opaque; full-size frames/disposal2/looping GIF89a. No chroma key or opaque matte.
subtitles: Authored phrase captions burned below the face into the SAME PNG/GIF frames in RGB(77,232,219), matching mesh ink. Each phrase uses its actual local speech duration rounded to GIF centiseconds. Not word-level forced alignment or an independently timed HTML element.
expressions: Explicit bounded Claire model inputs per phrase: neutral, joy, anger, amazement and sadness. Transitions are successive generated clips, not inferred emotions, continuous one-take speech or human-accepted realistic expressions. Dramatic cue descriptions are editorial intent.

isolation: Hidden real production Electron renderer/sandbox/preload. No window.show/focus/pinning, follow disabled, muted speech; separate loopback capability/RAM server/cache/synthesis and disposable profile. Owners stopped and profile removed.
limits: Silent sampled GIFs, not an audio demo, real-time cadence, hair physics, listening/likeness/phonetic acceptance. GIF has binary transparency, losing sub-threshold antialias coverage. Fictional dialogue does not describe face capture or identity theft capabilities.
